lines.zh: 沉重十字架下，我行将就木。
lines.en: Under the heavy cross, I walk to my doom.

lines.zh: 异端监狱的阴影中，我蹒跚前行。
lines.en: In the shadow of the heretic prison, I stagger forward.
With sin upon my back, I walk with a heavy step.

lines.zh: 十字架压迫，我只能匍匐前进。
lines.en: The cross crushes me, forcing me to crawl.

lines.zh: 囚徒的低语在黑暗中回响。
lines.en: The whisper of a prisoner echoes in the darkness.

lines.zh: 我沉重的脚步声，回荡在空无一人的牢房。
lines.en: My heavy footsteps echo in the empty cells.

lines.zh: 十字架下的亡灵，缓慢前行。
lines.en: The spectral wraith moves slowly under the cross.

lines.zh: 沉重枷锁，阻碍我的每一步。
lines.en: The heavy shackles hinder every step I take.

lines.zh: 我被罪行压垮，只能前进。
lines.en: Bowed under sin, I can only move forward.

lines.zh: 在牢狱的绝望中，我行进。
lines.en: In the despair of the prison, I walk on.

lines.zh: 牢门半开，我拖着镣铐挪步。
lines.en: The cell door hangs open; I drag my shackles along.
At the end of the stone corridor I lurch, step by step.

lines.zh: 十字架压迫，我无处可逃。
lines.en: The cross oppresses me, leaving no escape.

lines.zh: 静默中，只有十字架与我为伴。
lines.en: In silence, only the cross accompanies me.
Bearing the heavy load, I can only remain still.
I am in this stillness of despair.

lines.zh: 十字架的压迫，让我无法动弹。
lines.en: The cross's oppression keeps me from moving.

lines.zh: 我被重物压得无法动弹。
lines.en: Burdened, I cannot move.

lines.zh: 十字架下的灵魂，只能静默。
lines.en: The soul under the cross can only be silent.
The heavy load pins me in place.

lines.zh: 我被枷锁束缚，无法动弹。
lines.en: I am bound by shackles, unable to move.

lines.zh: 十字架压迫，我只能沉默。
lines.en: The cross oppresses me, leaving me silent.

lines.zh: 我数着牢房里的砖，数着罪。
lines.en: I count the bricks of my cell, and my sins.

lines.zh: 十字架倚墙，我低头不语。
lines.en: The cross leans on the wall; I bow my head in silence.

lines.zh: 走廊无人，只有铁链轻响。
lines.en: No one in the corridor, only the whisper of chains.
Awaiting the verdict, I do not stir.

lines.zh: 你那双眼睛，看到了我的罪。
lines.en: Your eyes see my sin.
You move, and I'm ready.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，我都在意。
lines.en: Your every move is on my mind.
Your presence, and I'm always ready.
Your actions, I anticipated.
Your shadow, I follow.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，我都注意。
lines.en: Your every move, I notice.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，我都不放过。
lines.en: I don't miss your every move.
You move, and I act.

lines.zh: 你也是被押进来的罪人？
lines.en: Are you a sinner hauled in here too?

lines.zh: 别盯着我背上的十字架。
lines.en: Don't stare at the cross on my back.

lines.zh: 你手里那块盾，挡不住我。
lines.en: That shield in your hand won't stop me.
I read sin in your eyes.

lines.zh: 靠近些，让我看清你的脸。
lines.en: Come closer, let me see your face.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸惊动了牢里的回声。
lines.en: Your breathing stirs the echoes of this cell.
Do you wish to enter the heretics' prison too?
Don't look at me with pity.

lines.zh: 你站的地方曾是审判席。
lines.en: You stand where the judgment seat once was.
If you don't step back, I'll rise.

lines.zh: 石墙上的刻痕，都认得你。
lines.en: Every mark on the stone wall knows you.

lines.zh: 沉重十字架压得我喘不过气。
lines.en: The heavy cross suffocates me.
My back bends under the weight of sin.
My steps are slowed by the chains.
The cross suffocates me.
Endless pain consumes me.
The chains bind me.

lines.zh: 沉重十字架压垮了我的灵魂。
lines.en: The cross crushes my soul.
Bearing the cross makes me wheeze.

lines.zh: 十字架压得我几乎窒息。
lines.en: The cross almost chokes me.
The chains tighten around my neck.

lines.zh: 你感受到我的重量了吗？
lines.en: Feel the burden I carry.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，赎不了罪。
lines.en: That little thing in your hand won't atone for anything.

lines.zh: 我的十字架能让你屈服。
lines.en: My crucifix will make you yield.
Sin will drag you into the abyss.

lines.zh: 放下罪恶，否则你会承受。
lines.en: Repent, or you'll suffer.
Your soul belongs to heresy.
I wait here for redemption.
Your fear is no match.
Penitent, eternal prisoner.
You cannot escape, heretic. Judgment awaits.
My crucifix collides with your shield.
My strength overwhelms your shield.
You're pushed back by the crucifix.
Your shield fails to protect you.
I push you back with my crucifix.

lines.zh: 十字架造成了巨大的击退。
lines.en: The crucifix creates great repulsion.
You're repelled by me.
You're repelled, penitent.

lines.zh: 十字架的力量无法忽视。
lines.en: The power of the crucifix is undeniable.
You're repelled by the crucifix.
The heretic prison is my home.
I wait here for a companion.

lines.zh: 我们一同受苦，一同赎罪。
lines.en: We suffer together, we repent together.

lines.zh: 只有同类才能理解我的痛苦。
lines.en: Only同类才能理解 my suffering.

lines.zh: 异端中的异端，我找到同伴了。
lines.en: Heresy within heresy, I've found a companion.
You're a heretic, you understand me.

lines.zh: 我们在绝望中寻找希望。
lines.en: We seek hope in despair.

lines.zh: 我是被遗弃的罪人，现在找到同伴。
lines.en: I'm a forsaken sinner, now I've found a companion.
We carry our sins together.

lines.zh: 异端中的罪人，我们是同类。
lines.en: Sinners of heresy, we are alike.

lines.zh: 十字架压得我喘不过气！
lines.en: The cross is too heavy!
My soul is as heavy as lead!

lines.zh: 监狱的食物连老鼠都不想吃！
lines.en: The prison food even rats won't eat!

lines.zh: 这里阴冷潮湿，适合我忏悔！
lines.en: This damp, cold place suits my repentance.

lines.zh: 我是忏罪徒，背着十字架前行！
lines.en: I am a penitent, bearing the cross.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声，是我的忏悔之音！
lines.en: My footsteps are my penitential hymn.

lines.zh: 盾牌能挡住我的力量吗？
lines.en: Can a shield stop me?

lines.zh: 我只相信十字架的力量！
lines.en: I only believe in the power of the cross!

lines.zh: 我背着的十字架，比任何重物都沉重！
lines.en: The cross I bear is heavier than anything.

lines.zh: 我只能在这里，忏悔我的罪孽！
lines.en: I can only repent here for my sins!
My gaze is on you!

lines.zh: 我背上的罪孽比十字架还重。
lines.en: The sin on my back outweighs the cross.
You are doomed to bear the cross!
You are my source of vengeance!
My cross will consume you!
You won't easily escape!

lines.zh: 十字架的重量，让你颤抖！
lines.en: The weight of the cross makes you tremble!

lines.zh: 你的命运在我的掌心中！
lines.en: Your fate is in my hands!
The cross is the only path!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我就是你的噩梦！
lines.en: You can't escape me, I am your nightmare!
Judgment begins: you are the accused.
The chains rattle; I have fixed on you.
I record your evidence with my own hands.
Don't run, the cell is already locked.

lines.zh: 我背的罪，今日由你分担。
lines.en: Today you share the sin I bear.

lines.zh: 钟声一响，你就成了靶子。
lines.en: When the bell tolls, you become the mark.
The cross guides my fury!

lines.zh: 我将把你钉在十字架上！
lines.en: I will crucify you!

lines.zh: 你将感受到十字架的痛苦！
lines.en: You will feel the pain of the cross!

lines.zh: 十字架会净化你的灵魂！
lines.en: The cross will purify your soul!
The cross is the only truth!

lines.zh: 我的十字架，将把你压垮！
lines.en: My cross will crush you!
The cross will make you submit!

lines.zh: 你将跪在我的十字架前！
lines.en: You will kneel before my cross!

lines.zh: 十字架的重量将压垮你！
lines.en: The weight of the cross will crush you!

lines.zh: 十字架将带走你的灵魂！
lines.en: The cross will take your soul!
Kneel and hear my verdict.

lines.zh: 十字架的影子已落在你身上。
lines.en: The shadow of the cross has fallen on you.
I'll read your charges one by one.

lines.zh: 别举盾，那只会让你晕眩。
lines.en: Don't raise that shield; it will only stun you.
Repent, there is still time.

lines.zh: 铁链拖地，是你的倒计时。
lines.en: These dragging chains count down for you.

lines.zh: 我把你的名字写进异端名册。
lines.en: I write your name in the heretics' roll.

lines.zh: 下一击会让你退得很远。
lines.en: The next blow will knock you far.
Judgment needs no witness.
The light on you is the fire of sin.
Heavy cross, sin's weight!
Cross strike, shake the ground!
Heavy steps, heavy burden!
Cross swings, fear spreads!
Bear the cross, painful journey!
Cross impact, pain descends!
Heavy chains, no escape!
Cross crash, tremble!
Painful weight, plead release!
Cross strikes, light of despair!
The cross sweeps wide and stone chips fly!
One heavy blow knocks you backwards!
Bone is my haft and sin my blade!
This stroke atones for you!
Raising your shield high won't save you!

lines.zh: 咚，是十字架落地的声音。
lines.en: Thud — the sound of the cross landing.
Convict escapes, vengeance comes!
Heretic prison, penitent awakens!
Darkness, sin awakens!
Prison light, unstoppable!
Chains break, penitent appears!
Bear the cross, eternal pain!
Penitent emerges, darkness returns!
Prison door, won't close!
Chains won't bind, penitent!
Soul of the prison, punishment descends!

lines.zh: 异端监狱，又多一名罪人。
lines.en: The heretics' prison gains another sinner.

lines.zh: 铁门开启，我背着十字架出来。
lines.en: The iron door opens; I come out bearing the cross.
The sentence is passed; here I serve it.

lines.zh: 骨荒原的风，吹不散我的罪。
lines.en: The wind of the Bone Wastes cannot blow away my sin.

lines.zh: 我自牢底爬起，镣铐未解。
lines.en: I rise from the cell floor, shackles still on.
The judge left; I stayed.

lines.zh: 血肉平原之上，我数着年头。
lines.en: On the Flesh Plains I count the years.
Repentance unfinished, the sentence begins.

lines.zh: 我的名字被刻在石墙上。
lines.en: My name is carved into the stone wall.
The guilty returns; the cell locks again.
My sins burn hotter than fire.
Falling tears my flesh.
Water pours in. My breath stops.
The explosion tears my chains.

lines.zh: 箭钉进十字架的木头里。
lines.en: The arrow buries in the wood of my cross.

lines.zh: 魔法的力量撕裂了我的灵魂。
lines.en: Magic tears my soul.
Hunger eats at my flesh.
Lightning rips me apart.

lines.zh: 无尽虚空吞噬了我的灵魂。
lines.en: The void consumes my soul.
